description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion API for frontier models (gpt-4o, Claude Sonnet 5.5), pay per call, no API key, over x402 USDC. Send messages, get choices + usage. Use when an agent needs a strong LLM without an account. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

messages.description: OpenAI-style messages: [{role: system|user|assistant, content: string}] (required). Input capped at ~8,000 tokens.

model.description: OpenRouter model id from this tier allowlist (default openai/gpt-4o).

name: agentbit.inference_chat_pro
title: Inference Chat Pro (OpenAI-compatible)
